episodes.title: The Greenlanders
episodes.summary: Plotting to avenge a massacre in England, Viking armies converge in Kattegat — but siblings Leif and Freydis exact a different kind of retribution.

episodes.title: Viking
episodes.summary: To save the life of Freydis, Leif agrees to join Canute and Harald's siege of London. Queen Emma dispatches stepson Edmund to secure an ally's help.

episodes.title: The Marshes
episodes.summary: On a pilgrimage, Freydis and her party are savagely attacked. Harald and Leif seek a route through the marshes near London as Edmund is crowned king.

episodes.title: The Bridge
episodes.summary: Leif proposes an audacious assault on London, one that Emma and Godwin fear their brash and headstrong boy-king, Edmund, will be too reckless to defeat.

episodes.title: Miracle
episodes.summary: Schemes, betrayals and politics rule the day as a new monarch takes the throne of England. Leif is hailed as a hero but secretly questions his faith.

episodes.title: The Last Daughter of Uppsala
episodes.summary: Freydis returns to Kattegat and joins a sacred order. Canute solidifies his power in England. Kåre revisits the holy site of a childhood trauma.

episodes.title: Choices
episodes.summary: Olaf makes a pact with Kåre as Kattegat prepares for its defense. In Canute's absence, his father, Sweyn Forkbeard, shares England's throne with Edmund.

episodes.title: The End of the Beginning
episodes.summary: Olaf and Kåre gather their forces to invade Kattegat. Palace intrigue over control of England's throne results in an unexpected turn of events.

episodes.title: The Web of Fate
episodes.summary: Olaf lands in a terrible position after Forkbeard invades Kattegat. In hiding, Freydis and Harald must decide whether to fight for the throne or flee.

episodes.title: Towers of Faith
episodes.summary: Freydis finds a new home. Harald formulates a daring new plan to take back Norway, but Leif's not on board. A new threat appears in London.

episodes.title: Pieces of the Gods
episodes.summary: While preparing for a journey to Constantinople, Harald assembles an unlikely crew, each with their own motives. Emma suspects Godwin of treachery.

episodes.title: The Thaw
episodes.summary: The travelers make a deadly miscalculation on the way to Constantinople. Olaf sets off after Harald, and Emma's paranoia pushes her over the edge.

episodes.title: Birth and Rebirth
episodes.summary: Harald learns a devastating secret. The group encounters a dangerous stranger. Harekr reveals his true intentions for the future to Freydis in Jomsborg.

episodes.title: Leap of Faith
episodes.summary: Love blossoms on the ship as the crew makes a fateful decision, with Olaf hot on Harald's heels. Jormundr stands trial. Canute makes Godwin an offer.

episodes.title: Pecheneg
episodes.summary: Harald makes a risky move and falls into the hands of the Pechenegs. Olaf sets out to find Jombsborg and stumbles upon an unlikely source of help.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: Leif says a painful goodbye. Harald's new love is not what she seems. A key battle comes to an end, but the war to rule over Norway is just beginning.

episodes.title: Seven Years Later
episodes.summary: Harald and Leif help Romanos lay siege at Syracuse. Canute travels to Rome to meet with the Pope. A new arrival in Jomsborg catches Freydis' eye.

episodes.title: Honour and Dishonour
episodes.summary: Harald fights the Emir for control of Syracuse. Something causes the Jomsborg townsfolk to fall ill. Magnus Olafsson unexpectedly arrives in Kattegat.

episodes.title: Lost
episodes.summary: As the Byzantine army returns to Constantinople, Leif agonizes over the Syracuse horror. Magnus sails to Jomsborg as Freydis' people begin to heal.

episodes.title: The End of Jomsborg
episodes.summary: Leif meets an unusual nun on his way to Corfu, Freydis devises a plan for Magnus' imminent arrival and Harald's indiscretion worries his friends.

episodes.title: Greenland
episodes.summary: Freydis reunites with her father, Erik the Red. Leif befriends mapmaker Calinicus, Canute returns to London and Harald gets caught in a bad situation.

episodes.title: Return to Kattegat
episodes.summary: Harald sacrifices everything to protect his friends, Canute gathers his sons in Kattegat and Erik tries to convince Freydis to stay in Greenland.

episodes.title: "Hardrada"
episodes.summary: Freydis confronts Erik over his schemes to make her stay, Canute declares a successor and Harald devises an escape plan.

episodes.title: Destinies
episodes.summary: Emma prepares to defend the throne. Magnus and Harald vie to be King of Norway. Unbeknownst to each other, Leif and Freydis both return to Kattegat.
